INUIAddVoiceShortcutButton.doc: A button that allows the user to add or edit a shortcut.

INUIAddVoiceShortcutViewController.doc: A view controller that guides the user through the steps for adding a shortcut to Siri.

INUIEditVoiceShortcutViewController.doc: A view controller that lets the user edit or remove an existing shortcut.

INUIAddVoiceShortcutButtonDelegate.doc: The protocol an object implements to receive notifications from the Siri Shortcut button.

INUIAddVoiceShortcutViewControllerDelega.doc: The protocol an object implements to receive notifications from the view controller adding a shortcut to Siri.

INUIEditVoiceShortcutViewControllerDeleg.doc: The protocol an object implements to receive notifications from the view controller that edits or removes a shortcut in Siri.

INUIAddVoiceShortcutButtonStyle.doc: The styles for the Add to Siri button.

INUIAddVoiceShortcutButtonStyleBlack.doc: A button with a black background.

INUIAddVoiceShortcutButtonStyleBlackOutl.doc: A button with a black background, and a border outlining the button.

INUIAddVoiceShortcutButtonStyleWhite.doc: A button with a white background.

INUIAddVoiceShortcutButtonStyleWhiteOutl.doc: A button with a white background, and a border outlining the button.

-initWithStyle:.doc: Creates an Add to Siri button with the specified style.

-initWithShortcut:.doc: Creates a view controller with a shortcut the user can add to Siri.

-initWithVoiceShortcut:.doc: Creates a view controller with the shortcut to edit or remove.

delegate.doc: The object that receives presentation requests from the button.

shortcut.doc: The shortcut Siri invokes when the user speaks the invocation phrase.

delegate.doc: The object that retrieves notifications from the view controller.
The object that retrieves notifications from the view controller.
